title: Conormal stalk as the cotangent module of the actual kernel
statement: For a closed immersion i and z ∈ Z, the stalk of the fixed degree-one piece [lem-pur-conormal-graded-algebra-basic] is additively isomorphic to K.Cotangent = K/K², K = ker(i_z). The isomorphism is semilinear for the fixed quotientStalk scalar map and takes the germ of every representative to the cotangent class of its ambient germ. All ambient opens are allowed; no Noetherian assumption is imposed.

proof.text: Apply the ideal-module-product stalk quotient to M=I. The ideal inclusion has stalk range K. Its image-product submodule becomes K·K under the injective range equivalence, so the quotient becomes K.Cotangent.

proof.text: The normalized unit quotient identifies I/I² with i_*i^*I. The closed pushforward stalk is bijective on the image and has the stated scalar formula. Composing these equivalences proves semilinearity and the representative-germ formula.

theorem conormal_stalk (z : Z) :
    ∃ e : ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor Z.toRingedSpace z).obj (piece i 1)) ≃+
        (RingHom.ker (i.stalkMap z).hom).Cotangent,
      (∀ (r : X.presheaf.stalk (i z) ⧸ RingHom.ker (i.stalkMap z).hom)
        (x : (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor Z.toRingedSpace z).obj (piece i 1)),
        e (quotientStalk i z r • x) = r • e x) ∧
      ∀ (U : X.Opens) (hz : i z ∈ U) (a : (power i 1).val.obj (op U)),
        ∃ h : X.presheaf.germ U (i z) hz
            ((powerInclusion i 1).val.app (op U) a) ∈ RingHom.ker (i.stalkMap z).hom,
          e (TopCat.Presheaf.germ (piece i 1).val.presheaf (i ⁻¹ᵁ U) z hz
            (representative i 1 U a)) =
              (RingHom.ker (i.stalkMap z).hom).toCotangent
                ⟨X.presheaf.germ U (i z) hz ((powerInclusion i 1).val.app (op U) a), h⟩
